request.prompt:
Use the supplied EXACT project ZOMBIE LORD reference as the only character design. A massive corpulent undead boss, pale gray-green mottled stitched skin, HUGE round exposed distended belly as the center of mass, tiny hunched neck and broad snarling head with sparse dark hair, very thick heavy arms and oversized bare feet. Preserve rusted nails/spikes in shoulder/back, heavy gold-rusted chains draped around neck/shoulders/chest and attached wrist shackles, ragged gray-brown skirt/loincloth, ornate antique gold pointed waist plate/belt. Both hands are EMPTY heavy fists/claws with connected chains; do not invent a sword, axe, shield, cape, horns or wings. Keep the SAME exceptional belly volume, broad shoulder/hip proportions, face, chain hardware and original muted palette in every pose. High-detail painted rendered mythic-tier fantasy RPG sprite, fixed elevated orthographic isometric camera. Non-graphic monster art: old mottled scar/stitch texture, no fresh blood or internal organs. Ignore unrelated tiny fragments at reference crop edges; reconstruct the complete top of head and full intact toes, never crop them.

STRICT REAR view facing AWAY directly TOP. Only nape, huge broad BACK, rear shoulder spikes/chains and rear legs. NO eye, nose, mouth, front belly button or waistplate. AnatomicalRIGHT leg is screenRIGHT, anatomicalLEFT screenLEFT. Grounded heels and rear-view planted feet clearly alternate. Keep this identical rear camera in all six poses.

Exactly SIX distinct chronological RUN keyframes arranged THREE columns and TWO rows: row1 phases0,1,2; row2 phases3,4,5. Pose0 RIGHT foot forward weight bearing / LEFT leg trailing. Pose1 RIGHT foot planted supporting mass / LEFT heel and whole foot lifted back with knee flexed. Pose2 RIGHT foot still planted / LEFT knee and entire foot swing FORWARD above ground. Pose3 LEFT foot forward weight bearing / RIGHT leg trailing. Pose4 LEFT foot planted supporting mass / RIGHT heel and whole foot lifted back with knee flexed. Pose5 LEFT foot planted / RIGHT knee and foot swing FORWARD above ground. Phase0 and3 MUST support on opposite ANATOMICAL feet. Real joint articulation, not sliding/translation or six copies. Huge belly stays huge but lags toward old support side; hips transfer mass to stance foot, knees compress, shoulders countershift, chains attached and heavy. Fast heavy shuffle, not agile jumping. At least one grounded sole every phase. Both bare feet visible below skirt.

Pure alpha0 transparent sprite sheet. SIX full complete SMALL bodies centered in 3x2 equally spaced cells. Each full bounding rectangle must occupy no more than45% cell width and55% cell height; HUGE EMPTY horizontal and vertical transparent gutters. No two bounding rectangles may intersect. Identical physical character scale all six frames. No clipping anywhere, ONE connected body percell, no loose rings/specks/shadow/floor/text/grid/labels. Camera correction and complete gaps take priority over filling sheet.
